text: Larry Elliot Klayman, of Washington, District of Columbia, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of June 8, 2026; and a rule having been issued requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Larry Elliot Klayman is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
